_comment: Tier-2 for dealii stokes#2. Tier-2 for dealii stokes#2 -- probe "pressure_nullspace" of the shared translation unit _shared/stokes_family.cc, compiled once and cached so every fixture that names a probe of that unit shares ONE C++ build. Lid-driven cavity, velocity Dirichlet on the whole boundary. The probe checks that the constant-pressure vector is in the kernel of the assembled matrix, then runs the SAME unrestarted GMRES twice differing only in the starting vector: the velocity agrees to 1e-10 and the pressure shape agrees to 1e-10, but the pressure LEVEL differs by exactly the shift put into the start. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 makes the probe run the CORRECT variant, and the fixture then fails its own expectations. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against deal.II 9.8.0-pre (Release at ~/dealii/build; Debug at the dbgbuild tree where the fixture sets requires_debug); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run.
